system.name: Quota Marketplace
system.one_liner: a dynamic-pricing marketplace that allocates ML training accelerator resources across teams and pools

components.name: pool 1
components.role: one resource pool containing multiple teams competing for supply

components.name: pool 2
components.role: a second resource pool, structurally identical to pool 1

components.name: pool N
components.role: the Nth resource pool, structurally identical to the others

components.name: team i
components.role: a team within pool 1 submitting workloads, credit info, and demand/bids

components.name: Credit Info
components.role: the team's budget/credit standing used in bidding

components.name: Demand + Bids
components.role: the team's resource demand and bid submitted to the market

components.name: pool supply
components.role: resources previously purchased and owned by a specific pool, with preferential access

components.name: Market Clearance
components.role: the mechanism that combines pool supply and shared supply to clear the market and set prices

components.name: shared supply
components.role: resources shared across all pools and managed centrally by the marketplace

components.name: pool N price
components.role: the price cleared for pool N

content.key_idea: Multiple pools, each containing teams that bid for resources with their credit and demand, feed into a market clearance mechanism that jointly considers pool-specific supply and shared supply to set a price per pool.
content.reading_order: Left to right across N repeated pool columns, each with teams and their workloads/credit/demand-bids stacked above a pool-supply box, all feeding down into a shared Market Clearance band, which outputs a price per pool at the bottom.

palette.used_for: light blue fill for team boxes and pool supply boxes
light red/pink fill for workloads boxes
light cyan fill for Credit Info boxes
light yellow fill for pool-price boxes
gray fill for Demand + Bids boxes

style.stroke: ~0.4pt black borders, dashed border around the Market Clearance band
style.font: ArialMT/Arial-BoldMT sans, 2.5-6pt, bold for pool/team/component titles
style.arrows: thin black lines connecting stacked boxes vertically within and across columns

encoding.color_means: pastel fill distinguishes component types repeated across pools: blue = team/pool-supply boxes, pink = workloads, cyan = credit info, gray = demand+bids, yellow/gold = cleared price - the same color always marks the same role in every pool column
encoding.line_style_means: a dashed black border isolates the Market Clearance band from the per-pool columns above and below it
encoding.emphasis: repeating identical column structure across pools 1..N emphasizes that the same per-pool mechanics feed into one shared Market Clearance step that unifies pool-specific and shared supply
reusable_patterns: N repeated identical columns feeding into one shared horizontal clearance band
layered team -> pool supply -> shared clearance -> price structure
weaknesses: very dense small text (2.5-6pt) across 60 text boxes may be hard to read at print size

evidence: Figure 2 shows that market clearance takes into account both pool supply and shared supply
supply previously purchased and owned by each business unit to which this unit has preferential access

summary: This figure gives the high-level concept of the Quota Marketplace (QM) system as a matrix of repeated pool columns feeding a shared clearance mechanism. Each of pool 1, pool 2, ..., pool N contains one or more teams (team i, team j, team k), each with workloads, Credit Info, and Demand + Bids stacked in a pastel-colored card. Below each pool's teams sits a pool supply box, representing resources previously purchased by that business unit with preferential access. All pool-supply boxes flow into a dashed-bordered Market Clearance band that also contains a shared supply resource pool spanning all pools. Market Clearance outputs a price per pool (pool 1 price, pool 2 price, pool N price) at the bottom. The repeated column structure across pools, unified through one shared clearance step, visually conveys that QM balances both pool-specific and marketplace-wide shared accelerator supply when setting prices.
summary_zh: 该图展示Quota Marketplace的高层概念：多个资源池(pool 1..N)各自包含多个团队及其工作负载、信用信息与需求出价，团队之上叠加各池专属供给，统一汇入带虚线边框的市场出清模块(内含跨池共享供给)，最终为每个池输出一个价格。
